subject: Path to Accepted POC — timeline & owners
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@stratagem.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Path to Accepted POC — next steps & tentative timeline

Hi Olivia / Jake —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Short recap and a proposed path to an accepted POC so we can get your team to a confident go/no-go in 3 weeks. Please confirm or flag adjustments.

1) High-level success criteria (from your notes):
- Accuracy: model responses must match internal routing taxonomy >= 92% on 2 pilot datasets
- Latency: 95th percentile inference < 350ms in your us-west-2 workload profile
- Data controls: logs stored in your VPC, retention 90 days, no customer PII persisted by Redwood

2) Proposed timeline (tentative) — 3-week compact trial
- Week 0 (prep): SOW + access, baseline data snapshot (you) — target Aug 6
- Week 1 (kickoff + integration): deploy sandbox, run ingestion, initial smoke tests — Aug 9 kickoff
- Week 2 (run & tune): label subset, tuning iterations, weekly sync — Aug 16 check-in
- Week 3 (final readout): consolidated metrics, artifacts, recommendations — Aug 27 final readout

3) Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood technical lead: Monica Patel (integration, test harness)
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter (weekly health checks, tuning)
- Stratagem technical owner: Jake Moreno (data access, test labels)
- Stratagem product: Olivia Hayes (acceptance criteria sign-off)

4) Ask from Stratagem today:
- Confirm success criteria above (accuracy/latency/data controls)
- Confirm kickoff date: Aug 9 (we can do 10:00 AM PT)
- Share baseline sample data (S3 link) and procurement contact for SOW
I attached a short POC template (redwood-poc-template.xlsx) and a blank SOW draft.

If that aligns, I will circulate a detailed POC plan and calendar invite with owners.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

- Success criteria: agreed on the three bullets, but can we tighten latency to 95th < 300ms? Our SLAs are aggressive — if that's a hard constraint for Redwood we can mark it as stretch.
- Baseline data: I will share an S3 presigned link for 3k sample events by EOD Tue (Aug 3).
- Procurement: please loop in our procurement lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@stratagem.ai) for the SOW and PO.

Kickoff: Aug 9 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team.

Hi all —

Per Olivia’s note, attached is POC Plan v1 (poc-plan-raf-v1.docx) and an editable SOW draft (sow-draft.pdf). I also included links to our SOC 2 in-scope statement and the shared Drive folder. Key highlights and a slightly updated schedule:

POC Plan highlights:
- Prep (by Aug 6): Stratagem to drop samples to S3 + procurement contact confirmed. Redwood to provision sandbox and generate access tokens.
- Kickoff (Aug 9, 10:00 AM PT): 45-minute technical walk-through, roles, and validation checklist.
- Week 1 (Aug 9–13): Integration + smoke tests. Deliverable: baseline inference run and latency dashboard.
- Week 2 (Aug 16–20): Iterative tuning. Deliverable: labeled sample set + updated metrics.
- Week 3 (Aug 23–27): Validation & readout. Deliverable: final metrics, artifacts, recommended next steps and optional production runbook.

Acceptance details (to be finalized):
- Primary gate: accuracy >= 92% on agreed validation set OR equivalent business KPI improvement (TBD).
- Latency gate: target 95th < 300ms as a stretch; we will record both 350ms and 300ms baselines in Week 1 for clarity.
- Security gate: SOC 2 in-scope statement and attestation that logs are routed to your VPC.

Logistics & links:
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-poc-resources
- SOC materials: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-in-scope.pdf
- SOW (editable): https://app.docusign.com/signon?env=demo&tenant=redwood&sow=DL-2027-0957

Attachments: poc-plan-raf-v1.docx, sow-draft.pdf

Next steps (Rafael / Stratagem procurement): sign SOW draft or confirm PO path; Stratagem to provide S3 link by Tue EOD; we will send calendar invites for kickoff and weekly milestones once SOW is agreed.

On a separate note — Ben will lead weekly tuning calls and Monica will be the lead for the integration work.

Thanks —
Rafael
